checks: Knowledge selection, evidence, version history, citation checks and keyboard navigation retain their context.
Late item responses are discarded; a failed item read exposes a working Retry.
Scoped search survives navigation, reports failures, ignores a canceled search and combines with status filters.
Personal and project scope changes clear prior records immediately; delayed and failed scopes never impersonate an empty store.
Proposal drafts survive selection and failed saves; approval is serialized and writing a provider file still requires its separate Apply action.
Teaching retains input focus and its draft; closing is read-only and submitting creates one explicit proposal.
Retirement names the selected item, requires a reason and retains its record after the explicit status change.
Briefing previews show exact payloads and estimated token costs; delayed responses cannot cross provider selections.
A failed refresh disables controls until Retry; window changes and one-shot Inbox links retain the intended filter across remounts.
Motion follows Off, Auto and Full preferences; the narrow desktop stays within its viewport.
Observed empty libraries and Inbox lists have distinct, actionable empty states.
